Safety.ContentWarning: Content warning: this module discusses addiction, recovery, sobriety, and relapse. The player has final authority over their character's Sobriety Triggers and how recovery or relapse is portrayed.

Manager.Title: Addiction Recovery — GM Manager
Manager.NoAddictions: This character is not currently marked as having an addiction.
Manager.DeleteWarning: This permanently removes this addiction and its local history from the character.

Addiction.Name: Addiction name
Addiction.Incurable: Cannot be resolved through recovery alone
Addiction.IncurableHint: Automatic increases and decreases of this Sobriety Die are locked. Only the GM can change its size.

Outcome.locked: Sobriety Die locked — GM control only

Trigger.Label: Sobriety Trigger
Trigger.PromptHint: A Sobriety Trigger is present. Choose how to roll your current Sobriety Die.
Trigger.Resolved: This Trigger roll has been resolved.

Rest.Title: Addiction Recovery
Rest.Checkbox: Use this downtime to work on sobriety
Rest.HintAll: When selected, every active addiction improves its Sobriety Die by the configured number of steps. A character in relapse enters or re-enters recovery at the lowest die.
Rest.HintSpecific: When selected, the addiction chosen below improves its Sobriety Die by the configured number of steps. A character in relapse enters or re-enters recovery at the lowest die.
Rest.SelectAddictionHint: Choose which one of this character's active addictions benefits from recovery during this Long Rest.

RestSettings.Title: Long Rest Recovery Targets
RestSettings.AllHint: Selecting Addiction Recovery during a Long Rest affects every active addiction on that character.
RestSettings.Specific: One addiction chosen during Long Rest
RestSettings.SpecificHint: The player chooses one of their character's active addictions in the Long Rest dialog. Only that addiction benefits from recovery.
RestSettings.OtherAddictionsHint: Choose what happens to the character's other active addictions during that Long Rest.
RestSettings.OtherDecrease: Treat the others as not selected and reduce their dice
RestSettings.OtherDecreaseHint: Every other active addiction loses the configured number of die steps. Addictions locked for GM-only die control remain unchanged.
RestSettings.OtherUnchanged: Do not reduce the other addictions
RestSettings.OtherUnchangedHint: Only the selected addiction is processed. Every other active addiction keeps its current Sobriety Die.

Notifications.NoPermission: You do not have permission to roll for this character.
Notifications.NotInRecovery: The Sobriety Die can only be rolled while the character is in recovery.
Notifications.GMOnly: Only the GM can send a Sobriety Trigger prompt.
Notifications.TriggerSent: Sobriety Trigger sent to the character and GM.
Notifications.TriggerAlreadyResolved: This Sobriety Trigger has already been resolved.
Notifications.ManualRollGMOnly: Only the GM can make a manual Sobriety Die roll. Players roll from a Sobriety Trigger prompt.
Notifications.VersionWarning: Addiction Recovery System was built for Foundry VTT 14 build 365 and dnd5e 5.3.3. Other versions are not supported by this release.

dieLadder.Name: Sobriety Die ladder
dieLadder.Hint: Comma-separated die sizes from weakest to strongest. Default: 4, 6, 8, 10, 12, 20.

maintainThreshold.Name: Maintain Sobriety threshold
maintainThreshold.Hint: A result at or above this number maintains the current Sobriety Die. Default: 2.

triggerDropSteps.Name: Trigger failure — die steps lost
triggerDropSteps.Hint: How many positions the Sobriety Die drops after a failed Trigger roll. Default: 1.

recoveryGainSteps.Name: Recovery downtime — die steps gained
recoveryGainSteps.Hint: How many positions the Sobriety Die improves when recovery is selected during downtime. Default: 1.

relapseOnMinimumFailure.Name: Relapse on a failed minimum die
relapseOnMinimumFailure.Hint: When enabled, failing a Trigger roll at the lowest Sobriety Die begins a relapse event.

uncheckedBehavior.Name: Long Rest when recovery is not selected
uncheckedBehavior.Hint: Choose whether leaving Addiction Recovery unchecked causes no change or reduces each active Sobriety Die.

completeAtMaximum.Name: Complete recovery above the maximum die
completeAtMaximum.Hint: Optional homebrew: when enabled, another improvement while at the maximum die marks a curable addiction as Recovered. Disabled by default to preserve the original rules.

playersEditTriggers.Name: Players may edit Sobriety Triggers
playersEditTriggers.Hint: Allows character owners to edit their own Trigger descriptions on the Inventory tab. The GM can always edit them.

defaultRollMode.Name: Default roll mode
defaultRollMode.Hint: Default visibility for Sobriety Die rolls. It can still be changed before each roll.

historyLimit.Name: History entries per addiction
historyLimit.Hint: Maximum number of Trigger and recovery events retained for each addiction. Set to 0 to disable history.

showQuickPanel.Name: Show movable GM panel
showQuickPanel.Hint: Shows the movable, lockable Addiction Recovery shortcut panel for GMs.

longRestRecoveryConfig.Name: Long Rest recovery scope
longRestRecoveryConfig.Label: Configure recovery scope
longRestRecoveryConfig.Hint: Choose whether recovery affects all active addictions or one selected by the player, and whether the other addictions lose a die step.
